crossRefs.note: Yahweh, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”
But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but we will only acknowledge your name.
One will say, ‘I am Yahweh’s;’ and another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand…
I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is…
Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.
For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.
“Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have…
“Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

translations.web: My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”
translations.bsb: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
translations.kjv: O my soul, thou hast said unto the LORD, Thou art my Lord: my goodness
translations.asv: O my soul, thou hast said unto Jehovah, Thou art my Lord: I have no good beyond thee.
